messages.text: What are the most important S-parameters capabilities for applications in Aerospace / Defense?

The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” Aerospace/Defense S-parameter list; the supported A&D-relevant context is satellite payload/component RF testing, where R&S ZNA is used for converter/mixer group delay, noise figure, amplifier, filter and antenna measurements [22][23].
- Wide frequency coverage: ZNA models cover 10 MHz to 26.5 GHz, 43.5 GHz, 50 GHz or 67 GHz depending on model [69].  
- High dynamic range and sensitivity: ZNA key performance includes dynamic range >129 dB specification without options, 147 dB typical with options, and up to 170 dB maximum attainable range allowing full 2-port correction; sensitivity is >–120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth specification without options and –162 dBm measured with options normalized to 1 Hz [25].  
- Accurate calibrated S-parameter measurements: ZNA effective system data conditions require +18 °C to +28 °C, calibration temperature variation ≤1 °C, identical measurement/calibration frequency points, bandwidth and sweep time, no interpolation, 10 Hz measurement bandwidth and 0 dBm nominal source power [71].  
- Group delay measurement capability: satellite payload testing identifies group delay as a major test topic and compares multi-carrier group delay measurement with the R&S ZNA two-tone technique [23].  
- Noise figure and gain-related RF component capability: the satellite payload source states R&S ZNA is used for noise figure and amplifier/filter/antenna measurements, and the ZNA options list includes R&S ZNA-K30 noise figure measurement [22][70].  
- Multiport / multi-receiver / phase-coherent capability: 4-port ZNA instruments have up to 4 independently configurable, phase-coherent, phase-controlled sources, a 5th source for LO supply, and 8 true receivers with no multiplexing [69].  
- Mixer/converter and mmWave support: R&S ZNA is used for converter/mixer group delay in satellite payload testing, and the ZNA options list includes scalar mixer, vector mixer, phase coherent source control, increased IF bandwidth, mmWave converter support and group delay measurements [22][70].  
- Time-domain and deembedding capability: the ZNA options list includes time domain analysis, extended time domain analysis, EaZy deembedding, in-situ deembedding and smart fixture deembedding [70].  
- TVAC-compatible calibration for satellite qualification: satellite payload qualification uses TVAC, where cables/adapters/switches drift with temperature and regular recalibration is needed; R&S ZN-Z33 inline calibration units can be placed in the chamber for remote re-calibration with the DUT in place, operating up to 40 GHz and TVAC compatible [80][30][33].

依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- Satellite payload qualification 需要使用 [[TVAC]] 進行 performance testing。
- Commercial off-the-shelf test and measurement equipment 無法在 TVAC conditions 下工作。
- Spectrum analyzers、vector network analyzers、signal generators 等設備必須留在 TVAC 外部，並以長 cables 連接 chamber 內的 DUT。
- Test setup 中的 cables、adapters 與 switches 會隨 TVAC temperature changes 發生 drift。
- 在不同 temperature 下於 chamber 中完成的 calibration 不再有效。
- 移動 cables 與改變 temperatures 後，需要 regular recalibration 以確保 measurement accuracy。
- TVAC 內 calibration procedure 特別困難，因 vacuum applied 時 operator 無法進入 chamber。

The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” Aerospace/Defense S-parameter list; the supported A&D-relevant context is satellite payload/component RF testing, where R&S ZNA is used for converter/mixer group delay, noise figure, amplifier, filter and antenna measurements [22][23].
- Wide frequency coverage: ZNA models cover 10 MHz to 26.5 GHz, 43.5 GHz, 50 GHz or 67 GHz depending on model [69].  
- High dynamic range and sensitivity: ZNA key performance includes dynamic range >129 dB specification without options, 147 dB typical with options, and up to 170 dB maximum attainable range allowing full 2-port correction; sensitivity is >–120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth specification without options and –162 dBm measured with options normalized to 1 Hz [25].  
- Accurate calibrated S-parameter measurements: ZNA effective system data conditions require +18 °C to +28 °C, calibration temperature variation ≤1 °C, identical measurement/calibration frequency points, bandwidth and sweep time, no interpolation, 10 Hz measurement bandwidth and 0 dBm nominal source power [71].  
- Group delay measurement capability: satellite payload testing identifies group delay as a major test topic and compares multi-carrier group delay measurement with the R&S ZNA two-tone technique [23].  
- Noise figure and gain-related RF component capability: the satellite payload source states R&S ZNA is used for noise figure and amplifier/filter/antenna measurements, and the ZNA options list includes R&S ZNA-K30 noise figure measurement [22][70].  
- Multiport / multi-receiver / phase-coherent capability: 4-port ZNA instruments have up to 4 independently configurable, phase-coherent, phase-controlled sources, a 5th source for LO supply, and 8 true receivers with no multiplexing [69].  
- Mixer/converter and mmWave support: R&S ZNA is used for converter/mixer group delay in satellite payload testing, and the ZNA options list includes scalar mixer, vector mixer, phase coherent source control, increased IF bandwidth, mmWave converter support and group delay measurements [22][70].  
- Time-domain and deembedding capability: the ZNA options list includes time domain analysis, extended time domain analysis, EaZy deembedding, in-situ deembedding and smart fixture deembedding [70].  
- TVAC-compatible calibration for satellite qualification: satellite payload qualification uses TVAC, where cables/adapters/switches drift with temperature and regular recalibration is needed; R&S ZN-Z33 inline calibration units can be placed in the chamber for remote re-calibration with the DUT in place, operating up to 40 GHz and TVAC compatible [80][30][33].

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]]：提供 satellite payload and components test and measurement solutions。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co KG]]：文件頁尾 copyright owner，© 2017–2022，地址標示 81671 Munich, Germany。
- [[R&S FSW]]：用於 group delay、linearity、NPR、signal quality、spurious、carrier-in-carrier 與 oscillator / synthesizer measurements；來源列 key features 為 up to 90 GHz、up to 500 GHz with external harmonic mixers、up to 8.3 GHz internal analysis bandwidth、800 MHz real-time analysis bandwidth。
- [[R&S SMW200A]]：用於 multi-carrier / modulated signal generation、OFDM waveform generation、DPD、NPR stimulus；來源列 key features 為 up to 67 GHz、up to 2 GHz I/Q modulation bandwidth、with [[R&S SMW-K555]] 可達 4 GHz signal bandwidth、optional second RF path up to 44 GHz。

- [[R&S FS-SNS]]：smart noise source，用於簡化 spectrum analyzer 的 noise figure and gain measurements。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]：TVAC-compatible automatic calibration unit，可放在 chamber 內做 inline recalibration。
- [[R&S NRP33SN-V]] 與 [[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：TVAC-designed three-path diode power sensors，分別支援 up to 33 GHz / 67 GHz。
- [[R&S RTP]]、[[R&S RTO6]]：oscilloscopes，用於 satellite digital interface trigger、decode 與 debug。
- [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]：本來源的總題目。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：比較 spectrum analyzer + signal generator 與 VNA two-tone technique 的測試主題。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 Rohde & Schwarz application brochure《Satellite payload and components testing》，文件代碼 `PD 5215.2120.92`，Version 02.00，文件日期標示 `September 2022 (ch)`，主題是使用 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器測試 [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]、transponders、modules 與 components。

- 衛星通訊系統支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems，並要求 24/7 reliable operation 與 multi-decade system longevity。
- 來源將 payload 技術演進描述為從 bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads 進展到 digital regenerative payloads；regenerative payloads 增加 system capacity 與 flexibility，但也增加 testing complexity。
- Bent-pipe payload channel 高階組成包含 uplink antenna、low noise amplifier、filter、frequency converter、filter、high power amplifier、filter、downlink antenna 與 local oscillator。
- Regenerative payload channel 在 RF chain 中加入 digital demodulator、baseband processing and switching、digital modulator 等功能區塊。
- 來源定位 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S ZNA]] 為 satellite payload / component RF testing 的核心儀器：[[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 偏 complete payload testing，[[R&S ZNA]] 偏 component level testing。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]] 是主要測試主題之一；來源比較 multi-carrier group delay measurement 與 [[R&S ZNA]] two-tone technique。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements 涵蓋 gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、NPR、ACLR、DPD 與 EVM 等 payload / component characterization。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 使用 chamber 外部測試儀器、長 cables、inline calibration modules 與 TVAC-compatible power sensors，以處理 temperature drift 與 vacuum 下無法人工進入 chamber 的 calibration 問題。
- Digital interface testing 涵蓋 [[SpaceWire]]、8b/10b-based [[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus trigger/decode/debug 測試。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。
- Speed example：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › Inline calibration units
依來源：

- [[R&S ZN-Z33]] automatic calibration units（model .03）設計為可在 TVAC 內運作。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]] 可永久連接於 test setup cables 與 DUT 之間，以便必要時 recalibration。
- Environmental conditions 下，只需一次 basic multiport calibration with through connections。
- Vacuum conditions 下的 temperature runs 中，inline calibration units 支援在 DUT in place 時進行 remote controlled re-calibration。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]] 透過 CAN bus 連接至 [[R&S ZN-Z30]] controller。
- [[R&S ZN-Z30]] CAN bus network 與 [[R&S ZN-Z32]]、[[R&S ZN-Z33]] calibration units 的控制整合於 [[R&S ZNA]] firmware 與 [[R&S SMARTerCal]] concept。
- Inline [[R&S ZN-Z33]] calibration unit operates up to 40 GHz，且可 TVAC compatible。
- [[R&S ZN-Z30]] controller 支援最多 48 個 calibration units。

R&S ZN-Z33 › 規格線索
來源列出以下線索：

- Inline [[R&S ZN-Z33]] calibration unit operates up to 40 GHz。
- TVAC compatible。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]] 在 factory 中針對 –30 °C 至 +80 °C temperature range 進行 characterized，以便在 vacuum conditions 下工作。
- Low insertion loss：typ. 1.5 dB at 1 GHz；5 dB at 40 GHz。
- High effective directivity：typ. 38 dB between 700 MHz and 20 GHz。
- [[R&S ZN-Z30]] controller 支援最多 48 個 calibration units。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › 測試問題
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- Satellite payload qualification 需要使用 [[TVAC]] 進行 performance testing。
- Commercial off-the-shelf test and measurement equipment 無法在 TVAC conditions 下工作。
- Spectrum analyzers、vector network analyzers、signal generators 等設備必須留在 TVAC 外部，並以長 cables 連接 chamber 內的 DUT。
- Test setup 中的 cables、adapters 與 switches 會隨 TVAC temperature changes 發生 drift。
- 在不同 temperature 下於 chamber 中完成的 calibration 不再有效。
- 移動 cables 與改變 temperatures 後，需要 regular recalibration 以確保 measurement accuracy。
- TVAC 內 calibration procedure 特別困難，因 vacuum applied 時 operator 無法進入 chamber。
